# Synthetic feed fixtures

Every company, posting, board and link here is invented. The `.invalid` domain
must never be fetched. `current.jsonl` uses actual canonical v1 fields; the tests
construct later successful, failed and unattempted runs from these two records.
The demo in `docs/static-feed-v1.md` writes an immutable manifest/snapshot locally.
No real posting or advertisement was copied into these fixtures.
